entries.title: John 9:1
segments: ¶Now as [Jesus] passed by, He saw a man who was blind from birth.

entries.title: John 9:2
segments: And His disciples asked Him, saying, "Rabbi, who sinned, this man or his parents, that he was born blind?"

entries.title: John 9:3
segments: Jesus answered, "Neither this man nor his parents sinned, but that the works of God should be revealed in him.

entries.title: John 9:4
segments: "I must work the works of Him who sent Me while it is day; [the] night is coming when no one can work.

entries.title: John 9:5
segments: "As long as I am in the world, I am the light of the world."

entries.title: John 9:6
segments: When He had said these things, He spat on the ground and made clay with the saliva; and He anointed the eyes of the blind man with the clay.

entries.title: John 9:7
segments: And He said to him, "Go, wash in the pool of Siloam" (which is translated, Sent). So he went and washed, and came back seeing.

entries.title: John 9:8
segments: ¶Therefore the neighbors and those who previously had seen that he was blind said, "Is not this he who sat and begged?"

entries.title: John 9:9
segments: Some said, "This is he." Others [said], "He is like him." He said, "I am [he]."

entries.title: John 9:10
segments: Therefore they said to him, "How were your eyes opened?"

entries.title: John 9:11
segments: He answered and said, "A Man called Jesus made clay and anointed my eyes and said to me, 'Go to the pool of Siloam and wash.' So I went and washed, and I received sight."

entries.title: John 9:12
segments: Then they said to him, "Where is He?" He said, "I do not know."

entries.title: John 9:13
segments: ¶They brought him who formerly was blind to the Pharisees.

entries.title: John 9:14
segments: Now it was a Sabbath when Jesus made the clay and opened his eyes.

entries.title: John 9:15
segments: Then the Pharisees also asked him again how he had received his sight. He said to them, "He put clay on my eyes, and I washed, and I see."

entries.title: John 9:16
segments: Therefore some of the Pharisees said, "This Man is not from God, because He does not keep the Sabbath." Others said, "How can a man who is a sinner do such signs?" And there was a division among them.

entries.title: John 9:17
segments: They said to the blind man again, "What do you say about Him because He opened your eyes?" He said, "He is a prophet."

entries.title: John 9:18
segments: But the Jews did not believe concerning him, that he had been blind and received his sight, until they called the parents of him who had received his sight.

entries.title: John 9:19
segments: And they asked them, saying, "Is this your son, who you say was born blind? How then does he now see?"

entries.title: John 9:20
segments: His parents answered them and said, "We know that this is our son, and that he was born blind;

entries.title: John 9:21
segments: "but by what means he now sees we do not know, or who opened his eyes we do not know. He is of age; ask him. He will speak for himself."

entries.title: John 9:22
segments: His parents said these [things] because they feared the Jews, for the Jews had agreed already that if anyone confessed [that] He [was] Christ, he would be put out of the synagogue.

entries.title: John 9:23
segments: Therefore his parents said, "He is of age; ask him."

entries.title: John 9:24
segments: So they again called the man who was blind, and said to him, "Give God the glory! We know that this Man is a sinner."

entries.title: John 9:25
segments: He answered and said, "Whether He is a sinner [or not] I do not know. One thing I know: that though I was blind, now I see."

entries.title: John 9:26
segments: Then they said to him again, "What did He do to you? How did He open your eyes?"

entries.title: John 9:27
segments: He answered them, "I told you already, and you did not listen. Why do you want to hear [it] again? Do you also want to become His disciples?"

entries.title: John 9:28
segments: Then they reviled him and said, "You are His disciple, but we are Moses' disciples.

entries.title: John 9:29
segments: "We know that God spoke to Moses; [as for] this [fellow], we do not know where He is from."

entries.title: John 9:30
segments: The man answered and said to them, "Why, this is a marvelous thing, that you do not know where He is from; yet He has opened my eyes!

entries.title: John 9:31
segments: "Now we know that God does not hear sinners; but if anyone is a worshiper of God and does His will, He hears him.

entries.title: John 9:32
segments: "Since the world began it has been unheard of that anyone opened the eyes of one who was born blind.

entries.title: John 9:33
segments: "If this Man were not from God, He could do nothing."

entries.title: John 9:34
segments: They answered and said to him, "You were completely born in sins, and are you teaching us?" And they cast him out.

entries.title: John 9:35
segments: ¶Jesus heard that they had cast him out; and when He had found him, He said to him, "Do you believe in the Son of God?"

entries.title: John 9:36
segments: He answered and said, "Who is He, Lord, that I may believe in Him?"

entries.title: John 9:37
segments: And Jesus said to him, "You have both seen Him and it is He who is talking with you."

entries.title: John 9:38
segments: Then he said, "Lord, I believe!" And he worshiped Him.

entries.title: John 9:39
segments: ¶And Jesus said, "For judgment I have come into this world, that those who do not see may see, and that those who see may be made blind."

entries.title: John 9:40
segments: Then [some] of the Pharisees who were with Him heard these words, and said to Him, "Are we blind also?"

entries.title: John 9:41
segments: Jesus said to them, "If you were blind, you would have no sin; but now you say, 'We see.' Therefore your sin remains.
